settings.show_app_name.label: Show application name
settings.show_app_name.description: Show the focused application's name in front of its menus.
settings.shortcut_menus.label: Shortcut menus
settings.shortcut_menus.description: Show curated menus for applications that export none. Clicking an item sends its keyboard shortcut to the window (needs wtype).
settings.fallback_menus.label: Fallback menus
settings.fallback_menus.description: Show window and session actions when the application exports no menu at all.
settings.max_menus.label: Menu labels in the bar
settings.max_menus.description: Maximum top-level menu labels shown before truncation; 0 shows every menu.
settings.bar_max_width.label: Menu bar width budget
settings.bar_max_width.description: Maximum width in px for the app name and menu labels before the rest moves under the » button; 0 fits to half of the screen width.
